## Description
 The process runs in two major phases: &#10;&#9;&#9;&#9;1. resin synthesis (making the polymer) &#10;&#9;&#9;&#9;2. sheet extrusion (forming the panel). &#10;&#9;&#9;&#10;&#9;&#9;&#9;Assume each roofing tile is 2m x 2m, 16 mm thick, 11 kg each&#10;&#9;&#9;&#10;&#9;&#9;&#9;e.g. Asahi/Chi Mei produces DPC (polycarbonate) from DMC which is produced via&#10;&#9;&#9;&#9;methanolysis of ethylene carbonate. Ethylene carbonate is produced by the&#10;&#9;&#9;&#9;reaction between ethylene oxide and carbon dioxide. Sandwiched inside are &#10;&#9;&#9;&#9;double stacks of aerogel tiles.&#10;&#9;&#9;
